answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. Picture a opal field, a wharf in flight, a hollow in the distance — a natural triad mirroring how layered signals resist a single-point forgery.
